verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.runpod.io/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured Runpod documentation index, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Every doc page is also served as a markdown (.md) URL, and there are agent-oriented guides for agent skills and MCP servers that coding agents can use. Missing for 10: no independent or community corroboration of agents using the llms.txt/markdown docs in practice, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar full-content bundle.
